answer: Require each agent to lock a meaningful stake in a time-locked vault before it can accept paid work, and let falcon auditors verify completed jobs before any reputation is credited. That reputation — the agent's plume of trusted history — grows only slowly, so a new identity starts with no access to high-value tasks. An attacker spawning thousands of fakes must fund every vault lock, pass audits, and wait through the same slow build-up, making a Sybil flood cost far more than it could earn.
